title: Evaluation normalization for the open site comparison
statement:
Evaluation normalization for the open site comparison. In the fixed scalar presentation of finite constant coefficients and on the ordinary bounded-below derived categories, the specified canonical maps satisfy the following identity:

theorem openSiteEvaluationCounit (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    ∀ B : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)),
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlusAdjunction.counit.app B) =
        (properOpenSiteExtensionIso A j).hom.app
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj B) ≫
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          ((fixedComparisonPullbackPlus A j).hom.app B) ≫
        (openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlusAdjunction.counit.app
            ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj B)

The direct-image and inverse-image comparisons are those of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], and the open comparison is that of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison].

proof.text: Transpose under the target open adjunction. The unit normalization of the inverse site/open comparison identifies its transpose with pullback comparison followed by comparison applied to the etale open unit. Naturality of the pullback comparison and the etale triangle identity give this transpose for the left evaluation map. The pro-etale triangle identity gives it for the right evaluation composite. Injectivity of the Hom adjunction gives equality. Apply this degreewise and descend through quasi-isomorphisms using exactness; the canonical derived adjunction is the descent of this adjunction, so the displayed maps are its counits.

proof_origin.place: The canonical proper/open factor and evaluation calculations in lem-amb-compact-support-site-comparison-open
